ownership_reason: Only the gold visits the elements of the range one by one; hops 1 and 2 see the range and its first element, hops 3 and 4 pass it along. Once a null element has been written as the text 'null' it cannot be told apart from an element whose text is 'null', so no caller can recover the joined String, and no one-line pre-filter maps null elements to empty text. The convention is pinned outside the gold: the facade's javadoc ('Null objects or empty strings within the array are represented by empty strings', [null, "", "a"], ';' = ";;a"); the String-separator overload join(Object[], String, int, int) and join(Iterator, char) skip null elements in the same loop ('if (array[i] != null)'); ObjectUtils.toString maps null to the empty String; StrBuilder.appendWithSeparators appends a null element as nothing (testAppendWithSeparators_Array expects "foo,,baz"); testJoin_ArrayString expects ",,foo" for the same array through the String overload.
